Kit summary

Wolf Blade SlashBasicExclusive Lv.2
Deals 2 stages of 280% DEF DMG each to a single enemy. This attack ignores [Immortal], [DMG Immunity], and [Shield].
Spiritual Weapon Lv.2Increases Brynhild's Turn Meter by 20% when she casts Wolf Blade Slash proactively, or increases her Turn Meter by 40% if the target's HP is below 50%; Brynhild acts 1 extra turn if this attack inflicts a kill. [Silence] inflicted by [Wolf Soul Cannonry] cannot be removed.
Soul of Wolf SpiritActiveExclusive Lv.1
Selects an ally and summons [Wolf Spirit] to possess them ([Wolf Spirit] can only possess up to 1 ally except self), reducing all the DMG taken by the possessed ally by 40%. Meanwhile, [Wolf Spirit] counterattacks the attacker, dealing 260% Brynhild's DEF DMG when the possessed ally takes active DMG. The [Wolf Spirit]-possessed ally cannot have [Consolidation]. Can be stacked with the buff [Counterattack].
Spiritual Weapon Lv.1There is an 80% chance to inflict [Hypnotize] for 1 turn when Soul-scouring Impact deals DMG. Meanwhile, DMG dealt by [Wolf Spirit] has an additional 40% Piercing Rate, which increases to 60% when Crit is landed. When Brynhild releases Soul of Wolf Spirit on [Wolf Spirit]-possessed allies, grants them [Surging Soul] for 2 turns, which grants them 1 immediate action turn and increases their Crit DMG by 40%.
Edgeless Heavy SwordPassive
Increases self All DMG Dealt by 28% and grants self 40% extra Crit DMG during the Heavy Sword form. Meanwhile, [Wolf Spirit] additionally pursues and attacks the main target when the possessed ally releases basic attacks proactively.
ProteanActiveExclusive Lv.3
Brynhild switches to the [Heavy Cannon Form] and resets the CD of Soul-scouring Impact. This skill's CD cannot be reduced or increased by other effects.
Spiritual Weapon Lv.3When casting Heavy Sword Out, increases all allies' Crit DMG by 60% for 2 turns; when casting Protean, resets the CD of all allies' active skills and increases their Tenacity by 60% for 2 turns.
Soul-scouring ImpactActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 370% DEF DMG to all enemies after removing all the buffs on them.
Spiritual Weapon Lv.1There is an 80% chance to inflict [Hypnotize] for 1 turn when Soul-scouring Impact deals DMG. Meanwhile, DMG dealt by [Wolf Spirit] has an additional 40% Piercing Rate, which increases to 60% when Crit is landed. When Brynhild releases Soul of Wolf Spirit on [Wolf Spirit]-possessed allies, grants them [Surging Soul] for 2 turns, which grants them 1 immediate action turn and increases their Crit DMG by 40%.
Wolf Soul CannonryBasicExclusive Lv.2
Deals 220% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to inflict [Silence] for 1 turn, and reduces the target’s Turn Meter by 15%.
Spiritual Weapon Lv.2Increases Brynhild's Turn Meter by 20% when she casts Wolf Blade Slash proactively, or increases her Turn Meter by 40% if the target's HP is below 50%; Brynhild acts 1 extra turn if this attack inflicts a kill. [Silence] inflicted by [Wolf Soul Cannonry] cannot be removed.
Heavy Sword OutActiveExclusive Lv.3
Brynhild switches to the [Heavy Sword Form], and resets the CD of Soul of Wolf Spirit. This skill's CD cannot be reduced or increased by other effects.
Spiritual Weapon Lv.3When casting Heavy Sword Out, increases all allies' Crit DMG by 60% for 2 turns; when casting Protean, resets the CD of all allies' active skills and increases their Tenacity by 60% for 2 turns.
